name: Altibox
verdict: A fibre broadband brand of the Lyse group, which is wholly owned by 15 Norwegian municipalities. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Eliteserien's league partner, on the right arm of Bodø/Glimt's 2026 shirt. Lyse AS is owned by 15 municipalities; public owners without a sourced record of abuses are not a tier (METHOD.md), so 'none'.
